requests.prompt: Minimalist geometric logo for a personal book library called 'Zhang Zining Book Library'. Design: a stylized open book with pages forming a graceful 'Z' shape, with a thin upward ascending chart line emerging from the pages, symbolizing learning-driven financial growth. Color palette: deep navy blue (#1f3a5f) as primary, warm gold (#c08a3e) as accent, on a clean off-white background (#f5f3ed). Style: flat geometric, modern, professional, suitable for a finance-economics content creator. Generous negative space, no text, no skeuomorphism. Vector-like crisp edges. Square 1:1.

Minimalist square favicon icon, 64x64 equivalent, for a personal book library.
